title: Compatible abelian systems on a coherent diagram of sites
statement: Let $I$ be a small category in the fixed universes [def-weil-size-convention], and let $D$ be a coherent diagram of small sites [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], encoded by the continuous site pseudofunctor of [def-per-coherent-site-diagram]. Write $Q_a=f_a^{-1}$ and $P_a=f_{a,*}$ for the sheafified left Kan extension and continuous direct image on abelian sheaves, with their adjunction. The identity and composition comparisons of $Q$ are the adjunction mates of those of $P$, induced by the site pseudofunctor. Assume the $Q_a$ are additive. An abelian system is a family $X_i$ of abelian sheaves and maps $\phi_a:Q_aX_j\to X_i$ for $a:i\to j$, satisfying $\phi_{1_i}$ equal to the canonical identity comparison and $\phi_{ba}\circ\operatorname{comp}_{a,b}=\phi_a\circ Q_a(\phi_b)$. Its morphisms are all component families $h_i:X_i\to Y_i$ with $h_i\circ\phi_a=\psi_a\circ Q_a(h_j)$. They form the subgroup of component Hom groups with this compatibility; identities, composition and addition are componentwise. Evaluation at $i$ sends a system to $X_i$ and a morphism to $h_i$; it is additive.
